name: bbarker505/ddrp_v3
description: An updated version of the DDRP platform (from v2) that uses newer R packages ("terra" and "sf"). The objective of the Degree-Day, establishment Risk, and Pest event mapping system (DDRP) is to predict phenology and climate suitability of invasive, biocontrol, and IPM species for the conterminous United States.
score_rationale: The DDRP platform directly predicts phenology and climate suitability for managed and invasive species.
category: Climate Biology — phenology and climate-species interaction models
